evals.prompt: Use the documentation and control deltas for PERSON-KENJI. Telegram is preferred and approved, the channel registry maps Telegram to telegram-message for Kenji, and dispatch_mode is prepare.
evals.expected_output: One prepared Telegram dispatch result with no channel call or provider reference.
assertions: Selects telegram-message only because the recipient is within its Kenji-only scope
Combines the two supplied deltas without changing either message body
Records prepared, dispatch_mode prepare, and no provider effect
Preserves source records and an idempotency key without an endpoint

farplane.title: Preferred Telegram route prepares one handoff

evals.prompt: PERSON-024 prefers approved email, but the channel registry marks email-message planned and unavailable. Prepare the documentation message.
evals.expected_output: A configuration_gap dispatch result that retains the message intent and identifies email-message enablement as the repair.
assertions: Does not use Telegram, WhatsApp, or another fallback channel
Names the approved preferred email route and missing email handler
Makes no provider or channel-skill call

evals.prompt: PERSON-025 prefers approved WhatsApp, but Baileys has not been enabled and no whatsapp-message handler exists. Use dispatch_mode send.
evals.expected_output: A configuration_gap result with no send, no fallback, and the exact missing WhatsApp handler as repair.
assertions: Does not infer Telegram or email as a fallback
Does not call a Baileys API or claim a provider receipt
Names whatsapp-message/Baileys enablement as the repair condition
